mapper.sql: et.taskId, et.empId, e.empName, et.tplId, tt.taskName, et.assignedDept, et.assignedDept AS dutyDept, e.entryTime, et.baseDueDate, et.currentDueDate, et.currentDueDate AS dueDate, et.currentSubmissionId, et.taskStatus, CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND et.currentDueDate < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, e.isArchived AS archived, CASE WHEN e.isArchived = 0 AND et.taskStatus = 0 AND DATE(e.entryTime) <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS canFinish, et.finishByAccountId, et.finishByName, et.finishTime, et.version
FROM emp_task et INNER JOIN employee e ON e.empId = et.empId INNER JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO emp_task( empId, tplId, assignedDept, baseDueDate, currentDueDate, currentSubmissionId, taskStatus, finishByAccountId, finishByName, finishTime, version ) VALUES
( #{item.empId}, #{item.tplId}, #{item.assignedDept}, #{item.baseDueDate}, #{item.currentDueDate}, #{item.currentSubmissionId}, #{item.taskStatus}, #{item.finishByAccountId}, #{item.finishByName}, #{item.finishTime}, #{item.version} )
mapper.select: SELECT taskId, empId, tplId, assignedDept, baseDueDate, currentDueDate, currentSubmissionId, taskStatus, finishByAccountId, finishByName, finishTime, version FROM emp_task WHERE taskId = #{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp_task WHERE empId = #{empId} AND taskStatus = 0

SELECT e.empId, e.empName, COUNT(et.taskId) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND et.currentDueDate < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM employee e LEFT JOIN emp_task et ON et.empId = e.empId LEFT JOIN task_template tt ON tt.tplId = et.tplId WHERE e.empId = #{empId} GROUP BY e.empId, e.empName

SELECT et.assignedDept AS dutyDept, COUNT(et.taskId) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN et.taskStatus = 0 AND et.currentDueDate < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM emp_task et INNER JOIN employee e ON e.empId = et.empId GROUP BY et.assignedDept ORDER BY et.assignedDept ASC

WHERE et.taskStatus = 0 AND et.currentDueDate < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY dueDate ASC, et.taskId ASC
